description: ClickHouse writer-insert foundation plus the two writers that depend on it: BaselineJob (writes xp_baseline from xp_metrics_1h via BaselineMath) and the events writer (derives xp_events from alert/anomaly lifecycle transitions and EC2 state changes). The xp_baseline (V005) and xp_events (V004) tables ALREADY exist, so no new table DDL — only a V008 GRANT file confirming the writer account's INSERT grant. This feature unblocks anomaly bands/METRIC_ANOMALY rules and the events timeline / what-changed view. Depends on nothing; must run before FEAT-002/003 only because it introduces the shared ClickHouseWrites seam.
steps: Add a parameterised INSERT seam. Create /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/platform/ClickHouseWrites.java (interface: void insert(String table, java.util.List<String> columns, java.util.List<java.util.List<Object>> rows) throws java.sql.SQLException) and JdbcClickHouseWrites.java (writer pool via ClickHouseConnections.writer(); build INSERT INTO <table> (<cols>) VALUES (?,...); validate <table> and every column name against a closed per-table whitelist {xp_baseline: tenant_id,metric,instance_id,hour_of_week,med,mad,updated_at ; xp_events: tenant_id,ts,kind,resource,title,detail} rejecting anything else with IllegalArgumentException; addBatch per row, executeBatch, chunk at 10000 rows). Follow the style of JdbcClickHouseMutations.java.

Register the bean. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/config/XamPulseClickHouseConfig.java to expose a @Bean("xpClickHouseWrites") ClickHouseWrites backed by JdbcClickHouseWrites(connections), guarded exactly like the existing mutations/ddl beans (same @ConditionalOnProperty).

Add the baseline source query. In /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/query/TenantScopedQueryBuilder.java add ScopedSql baselineSamples(QueryScope scope, String metric, int windowDays): SELECT instance_id, toUnixTimestamp(ts) AS t, avgMerge(avg_state) AS v FROM xp_metrics_1h with tenant predicate first (reuse start()), AND metric = ? (bound), AND ts >= toDateTime(?,'UTC') (now - windowDays), GROUP BY instance_id, ts ORDER BY instance_id, t. Keep the invariant: tenant ids are the first params, no user text concatenated.

Add Baseline properties. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/config/XamPulseProperties.java: new nested Baseline class with enabled (default true), windowDays (default 14), cron (default "0 20 * * * *"), metrics (default List.of("system.cpu.utilization","system.memory.utilization","system.filesystem.utilization","system.cpu.load_average.1m")); add getBaseline(). Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/resources/application.properties (XamPulse block ~line 1200) adding xampulse.baseline.enabled, .window-days, .cron, .metrics with ${XAMPULSE_BASELINE_*:default} placeholders and a short comment.

Create BaselineJob. /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/insight/BaselineJob.java as @Component("xpBaselineJob") @ConditionalOnProperty(name="xampulse.enabled", havingValue="true"). Inject XpAccountConfigRepository, ClickHouseExecutor, ClickHouseWrites, SchedulingEnvironmentConfig, XamPulseProperties, (QueryScopeFactory not needed — build QueryScope.of directly like ClickHouseTelemetryProbe). @Scheduled(cron = "${xampulse.baseline.cron}") runAll(): return early if !scheduling.isSchedulingEnabled() or !props.getBaseline().isEnabled(); for each XpAccountConfig in configs.findAll() whose SetupStateMachine.parse(state) is CONNECTED or DEGRADED, call runForAccount in its own try/catch (swallow, log class name). runForAccount(tenantId): for each metric in props.getBaseline().getMetrics(): QueryScope.of(List.of(tenantId), now.minusDays(windowDays), now.plusSeconds(60)); executor.query(builder.baselineSamples(scope.forTenant(tenantId), metric, windowDays)); group rows into Map<String instance, List<BaselineMath.Sample>>; for each instance call BaselineMath.compute(samples) and build rows (tenant_id, metric, instance_id, hour_of_week, med, mad, now()) for each surviving hour-of-week slot; writes.insert("xp_baseline", cols, rows). Build QueryScope via the executor.queryEach/forTenant pattern so the single-tenant invariant holds.

Create the events writer. /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/insight/EventWriter.java as @Service("xpEventWriter") @ConditionalOnProperty guarded, injecting ClickHouseWrites. Method record(long tenantId, String kind, String resource, String title, String detail, java.time.Instant ts): reject kind not in EventQueryService.KINDS; insert one row into xp_events (ts as java.sql.Timestamp/epoch-milli per the existing JDBC binding). Null detail -> empty string.

Emit events from the alert lifecycle. Edit /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/alert/AlertEvaluator.java to inject EventWriter (make it optional/nullable so existing AlertEvaluator unit tests that construct it directly keep compiling — e.g. a second constructor or @Autowired(required=false)). In onFiring, after openOrJoin, call eventWriter.record(accountId, cond.type()==METRIC_ANOMALY ? "ANOMALY" : "ALERT", instance, rule.name()+" firing", text, now) inside a try/catch that never fails evaluation. On resolution (the resolve branch in apply) record an ALERT "recovered" event the same way.

Create the EC2 state event projection. /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/insight/Ec2StateEventProjection.java as @Component("xpEc2StateEventProjection") @ConditionalOnProperty + @Scheduled, reading EC2 instance state transitions from the existing inventory projection service for CONNECTED/DEGRADED accounts and recording EC2_STATE events via EventWriter, deduped by resource+state+hour (in-memory last-seen map). Swallow all errors. If wiring to the inventory projection proves to need a dependency that is awkward to mock, keep this projection minimal and clearly annotate it; the ALERT/ANOMALY path is the primary deliverable.

Add the V008 writer-grant DDL. Create /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-service/src/main/resources/xampulse/clickhouse/V008__writer_insert_grants.sql with idempotent GRANT INSERT ON <db>.xp_baseline TO xp_writer_role and GRANT INSERT ON <db>.xp_events TO xp_writer_role (confirm against V006/V007 whether these are already covered; if so, make the file a documented no-op/comment plus any genuinely missing grant). Also confirm the reader role can SELECT xp_metrics_1h for baselineSamples; if V006/V007 already grant it, do nothing. NEVER edit V001..V007. Update the ClickHouse-scripts/migration-files test expectations (script count, V001..V008 ordering) in the existing XamPulseClickHouseScriptsTest / XamPulseMigrationFilesTest.

Add unit tests: ClickHouseWritesTest (column/table whitelist rejection, batching, >10k chunking, uses a fake Connection/PreparedStatement), BaselineJobTest (fake executor returns >=3 synthetic hourly samples in one hour-of-week slot for 2 instances; assert writes.insert called with table xp_baseline, exact columns, med/mad equal to BaselineMath.compute, cold-start slots omitted; a thrown executor error for account A does not stop account B; disabled flag -> no writes), EventWriterTest (insert row shape, kind whitelist rejection), AlertEventEmissionTest (FIRED -> EventWriter.record kind ALERT, METRIC_ANOMALY -> ANOMALY, resolve -> recovered; EventWriter exception does not fail evaluation), Ec2StateEventProjectionTest (dedupe, error swallow), plus baselineSamples cases in TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest. Put tests under xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse/service/{platform,insight,alert,query}.
acceptance_criteria: Running mvn -B -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest='com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.platform.ClickHouseWritesTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.insight.BaselineJobTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.insight.EventWriterTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.insight.Ec2StateEventProjectionTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.alert.AlertEventEmissionTest,com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.query.TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false passes with 0 failures.
The existing AlertStateMachineTest, AlertSupportTest and XamPulseClickHouseScriptsTest/XamPulseMigrationFilesTest still pass.
No edits to V001..V007; V008 added; xp_baseline/xp_events table DDL unchanged.
Every new bean is xampulse.enabled-guarded and xp<Name>-named; BaselineJob and Ec2StateEventProjection gate on isSchedulingEnabled() and swallow ClickHouse errors.
findings: IMPLEMENTED. Write seam: interface com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.service.platform.ClickHouseWrites with `void insert(String table, java.util.List<String> columns, java.util.List<java.util.List<Object>> rows) throws java.sql.SQLException`; impl JdbcClickHouseWrites (writer pool, closed per-table whitelist {xp_baseline: tenant_id,metric,instance_id,hour_of_week,med,mad,updated_at ; xp_events: tenant_id,ts,kind,resource,title,detail}, IllegalArgumentException on unknown table/column/row-width, addBatch + executeBatch, chunk const JdbcClickHouseWrites.CHUNK=10000). Bean @Bean("xpClickHouseWrites") in XamPulseClickHouseConfig, same @ConditionalOnProperty(xampulse.enabled=true) as mutations/ddl. Query: TenantScopedQueryBuilder.baselineSamples(QueryScope, String metric, int windowDays) -> SELECT instance_id, toUnixTimestamp(ts) AS t, avgMerge(avg_state) AS v FROM xp_metrics_1h, tenant-first, metric and (scope.to - windowDays*86400) bound; windowDays validated 1..400. Props: XamPulseProperties.Baseline nested class (enabled=true, windowDays=14, cron="0 20 * * * *", metrics default list) + getBaseline(); application.properties keys xampulse.baseline.enabled/.window-days/.cron/.metrics with XAMPULSE_BASELINE_* placeholders. BaselineJob @Component("xpBaselineJob") @Scheduled(cron=${xampulse.baseline.cron}) runAll()/runForAccount(long tenantId, Instant now); gates on isSchedulingEnabled() && baseline.enabled; active accounts = SetupStateMachine.parse(state) in {CONNECTED,DEGRADED}; groups rows by instance, BaselineMath.compute per instance, writes cols BaselineJob.COLUMNS order (tenant_id,metric,instance_id,hour_of_week,med,mad,updated_at) with updated_at as java.sql.Timestamp.from(now); per-account try/catch swallows (logs class name). EventWriter @Service("xpEventWriter") record(long tenantId,String kind,String resource,String title,String detail,java.time.Instant ts) throws SQLException; rejects kind not in EventQueryService.KINDS (made public); ts bound as java.sql.Timestamp.from(ts); null detail/resource/title -> "". AlertEvaluator: optional EventWriter via @Autowired(required=false) field + package-private setEventWriter(..) test seam (constructor unchanged so existing tests compile); emitEvent(..) called after openOrJoin (kind ANOMALY when condition.type()==METRIC_ANOMALY else ALERT) and on resolve branch ("<rule> recovered"), wrapped in try/catch that never fails evaluation. Ec2StateEventProjection @Component("xpEc2StateEventProjection") @Scheduled(cron=${xampulse.baseline.cron}); reads via a minimal Ec2StateEventProjection.Ec2StateSource seam (nested @Component InventoryEc2StateSource wraps InventoryProjectionService.flatList filtered to EC2 resources with non-blank state; note XamPulse tenant_id == cloud_account PK used by inventory); records EC2_STATE deduped by tenant|resource|state per UTC hour via in-memory map; swallows all errors. DDL: V008__writer_insert_grants.sql = idempotent restatement of GRANT INSERT ON xp_baseline/xp_events TO xp_writer_role (V006 already grants these and reader SELECT on xp_metrics_1h, so V008 is a documented defensive no-op); V001..V007 untouched; xp_baseline/xp_events DDL unchanged. Test updates: ClickHouseMigrationRunnerTest expects V001..V008; XamPulseClickHouseScriptsTest gained writerCanInsertTheSliceETablesAndReaderCanSelectTheBaselineSource. New tests under service/{platform,insight,alert,query}: ClickHouseWritesTest, BaselineJobTest, EventWriterTest, Ec2StateEventProjectionTest (+ shared FakeClickHouseWrites), AlertEventEmissionTest, baselineSamples cases in TenantScopedQueryBuilderTest. VERIFICATION: `mvn -q -B -pl xamops-service -am compile -DskipTests` OK; full XamPulse suite `-Dtest=com.xammer.cloud.xampulse.**` = 412 run, 0 failures (XamPulseWiringTest/BeanNaming green with the new beans). DEVIATIONS: (1) EventQueryService.KINDS visibility widened from package-private to public so EventWriter (different package) can reference it. (2) EventWriter.record throws SQLException (callers wrap/swallow) rather than swallowing internally, so BaselineJob/projection control their own error handling. (3) Ec2StateEventProjection shares the baseline cron key rather than introducing a new property, to avoid adding config surface for the secondary deliverable.
